requirement_vague: Verify user deletion fails when user has articles (FK constraint, no cascade delete)

omissions.description: There is no DELETE /api/users/{email} endpoint in the code. The requirement tests that deleting a user via DELETE /api/users/orphanauthor1@test.com returns a 500 error due to FK constraint violation.
omissions.reasoning: Searching the entire codebase, there is no route defined for DELETE /api/users/{email} or any user deletion endpoint at all. Without this endpoint, the scenario cannot be executed and the FK constraint behavior cannot be verified.
